title: Tsetan's farewell at Darchen
body: After a sleepless night at Darchen, during which he was afraid that he might never wake up if he fell asleep, the author was taken by Tsetan to the new medical college. A Tibetan doctor told him he had a cold and the effects of altitude, and gave him a five-day course of Tibetan medicine. After the first full day of medicine the author slept soundly. Once Tsetan saw that the author was going to live, he left him to return to Lhasa. The author reports Tsetan's parting thought: as a Buddhist, Tsetan knew that it did not really matter if the author passed away, but he thought it would be bad for business.
